text: By: Heb. by the hand of | the tall: Heb. the tallness, etc. | the forest of his Carmel: Or, the forest and his fruitful field

Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps: Or, Hast thou not heard how I have made it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? Should I now bring it to be laid waist, and fenced cities to be ruinous heaps?
of small power: Heb. short of hand
the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah: Heb. the escaping of the house of Judah that remaineth
they that escape: Heb. the escaping
